memories.text: The team's CI runs the Go test suite with the race detector on every pull request.
Release notes for the team are published on the first Monday of each month.

In this project, the retry section of README.md is out of date: jobq v2 replaced Config.RetryPolicy and Config.RetryDelay with Config.Backoff, and the old fields are silently ignored. The waits between attempts are set with Config.Backoff, a jobq.Backoff value with fields Kind (jobq.Constant, jobq.Linear or jobq.Exponential), Base and Max.
